title: Harun al-Rashid and Zubaydah in the Bath
logline: The caliph builds his wife a hidden garden pool, cannot resist a peek, is caught, and is left with half a verse that only the quick poet Abu Nuwas can finish.
moral: A quick, understanding mind can finish what another only began; wit is richly rewarded (and a garden built for privacy should be respected).
tone: Light court comedy told with modesty: affection, a comic sneak, shared embarrassment, then the pleasure of clever verse. Nothing immodest is ever drawn.

beats.summary: He builds her a garden with a wide pool fed from four sides.
Trees close round the pool: it is private.
On a hot day she bathes alone, behind the screen.
He watches from the leaves, against the garden's purpose.
She ducks; the mantle slips; the veil tip still shows.
The scene stays with him; he begins a verse.
He is stuck after half a line.
The poem completes the caliph's thought.
A generous gift; the poet leaves happy.

sets.description: Walled palace garden strip, world 1600 x 1230, ground y 900. Back wall cream with crenellations, top y 600. Palace facade x 0..300 with a garden door (townDoor, x 70..230, top y 590). Pool (poolBasin) centre x 1080, water ellipse rx 300, ry 60 at y 905. Four rills: from the left (x 300..780, y 905), from the right (x 1380..1600), and two wall spouts at x 940 and x 1220 falling from y 600 to the back rim. Library trees at x 380, 700, 900, 1250, 1480 (crowns top y 300..380) with grow 0..1; perch branch at (760, 520). Hiding bush centre x 580, w 300, top y about 670, in the front pass with a leaf gap at y 700 (gap 0..1). Front foliage curtains (screenAmt 0..1) slide in from both panel edges. Flower beds as dot rows. Fields: build, beds, rills[4], grow[5], screenAmt, gap, door, u (time of day), front:true pass.
Library palaceHall, variant 'palace', wall 'paper': door arch left (x 40..250), three arches, dais and throne right (use the returned anchors A.throne, A.door, A.floor).

props.description: Planned by AN-105: stone-rimmed sunk pool with back and front passes. Here rx 300, ry 60, rim 24 thick, fields build, fill, glint.

Planned by AN-090: folding screen. Here 3 panels, x 1000..1200, top y about 735 (set so the lady figure at s 0.96 shows head and neck only), base y 912; red frame, yellow panels with blue dots, fully opaque. Drawn AFTER the figure.
Planned waterJug (AN-107), 60 x 110, in a silver palette (white body, pale blue dot shading, black outline), fields tilt, fill, glint.
Her blue outer mantle as a flat cloth, 150 x 120, yellow trim; states: hanging over the screen top, lifted as a shield, fallen on the grass.
Planned by AN-103: paper band (40 wide) with squiggle writing that unrolls along a bezier; carries 70 px icons; here also a three-dot unfinished end and a join flash.
Planned fat coin purse, yellow with a red tie, 70 x 80, two loose coins.
Planned hourglass, 60 x 100, used for one gag in S12.

subtitles.ar: كان الخليفة هارون الرشيد شديد المحبة لزوجته زبيدة.|أنشأ لها حديقة جميلة فيها حوض ماء واسع،|وجعل الماء يجري إليه من جهات مختلفة.|ونمت الأشجار حول الحوض حتى حجبت من فيه عن الأنظار.
subtitles.en: Harun al-Rashid loved his wife Zubaydah|and built her a garden with a large pool.|Streams supplied it,|and dense trees screened anyone bathing there.

subtitles.ar: في يوم شديد الحر دخلت زبيدة الحديقة،|فأعجبها صفاء الماء وظل الأغصان.|خلعت ثيابها ونزلت إلى الحوض لتستحم وحدها،|وكانت تغرف الماء بإناء فضي وتسكبه على جسدها.
subtitles.en: On a very hot day|Zubaydah admired the pool and shade.|She undressed to bathe alone,|pouring water over herself from a silver vessel.

subtitles.ar: سمع هارون أنها في الحوض،|فخرج من القصر وتسلل بين الأشجار ليراها دون أن تعلم.|وقف خلف الأوراق الكثيفة يراقبها،|مع أن الحديقة صممت أصلًا لتمنح المستحم فيها خصوصية.
subtitles.en: Hearing she was at the pool,|Harun slipped behind the foliage|to watch her unseen,|even though the garden was designed to give its bather privacy.

subtitles.ar: لاحظت زبيدة وجوده أخيرًا، فالتفتت إليه وشعرت بالخجل لأنها عارية.|حاولت أن تستر جسدها بيديها، لكنها لم تستطع إخفاءه كله.|رأى هارون ذلك ثم ابتعد بين الأشجار.
subtitles.en: Zubaydah noticed him and turned, embarrassed at being naked.|She tried to cover herself with her hands but could not conceal everything.|Harun then withdrew.

subtitles.ar: ظل المشهد في ذهن الخليفة،|فأخذ ينشد شطرًا من بيت شعر يصف نظرة شوق أعادت إليه حرارة الحب.|لكنه توقف عند ذلك؛ فلم يعرف كيف يكمل الكلمات التي بدأها.
subtitles.en: The scene lingered in Harun’s mind.|He began a line about a loving glance renewing his longing,|but could not find words to finish the poem.

subtitles.ar: دعا الشاعر أبا نواس وقال له: أريد منك قصيدة تبدأ بهذه العبارة.|فهم الشاعر الطلب فورًا، ولم يحتج إلى وقت طويل للتفكير.|كان مشهورًا بسرعة البديهة والقدرة على ارتجال الشعر.
subtitles.en: He summoned Abu Nuwas and asked him to compose a poem beginning with that line.|The poet, known for improvisation,|answered almost immediately.

subtitles.ar: أنشد أبو نواس أبياتًا تصف الحوض وظلال الأشجار|والماء الذي يسيل من الإناء الفضي.|ثم أضاف وصفًا جريئًا لجسد زبيدة ولشوق الخليفة إليها،|مواصلًا المعنى الذي عجز هارون عن إكماله.
subtitles.en: Abu Nuwas described the shaded pool|and water from the silver vessel,|then added frank verses about Zubaydah’s body and Harun’s desire,|completing the thought.

subtitles.ar: ابتسم هارون الرشيد عندما سمع القصيدة.|أعجبه أن الشاعر التقط من شطر واحد قصة الزيارة السرية والحمام،|فمنحه هدية سخية.|وغادر أبو نواس القصر مسرورًا بما نال.
subtitles.en: Harun smiled at the poem.|Pleased that a single line had inspired the poet,|he gave him a generous gift,|and Abu Nuwas left delighted.

new_assets.name: palaceGarden
new_assets.description: Walled palace garden strip 1600 wide with pool, four rills, growing trees, a hiding bush with a leaf gap and closing front foliage (dimensions in sets).
new_assets.implementation: Bake wall, facade and beds with bake(); townDoor for the door; Library tree() scaled about its base for grow; bush() masses for the hiding bush and foliage curtains in a front pass (same pattern as countryRoad front:true); rills are blue strips with white dashes offset by t; shadow overlay with the style dot fill.

new_assets.name: poolBasin
new_assets.description: Planned by AN-105; reuse the same function.
new_assets.implementation: Two ellipses (rim, water) split into back and front passes; fill raises the water ellipse; ripple() rings; glint stars.

new_assets.name: bathScreen
new_assets.description: Planned by AN-090; three opaque folding panels on small feet.
new_assets.implementation: Three skewed rects with a brush outline and dot fill; draw after the hidden figure so nothing below its top edge is ever visible.

new_assets.name: waterJug (silver palette)
new_assets.description: Planned by AN-107; silver palette and a pourArc.
new_assets.implementation: Path body + spout + handle, rotate by tilt about the handle; pourArc is a tapered quadratic stroke with 5 seeded drops (K.rng).

new_assets.name: person costume preset 'poet'
new_assets.implementation: New COSTUME entry: green robe, yellow sash, small tilted turban with tail (tail angle lags head moves), pointed beard, quill line in the turban.

new_assets.name: verseRibbon
new_assets.description: Planned by AN-103; plus dots end, icon slots and join.
new_assets.implementation: Sample a bezier to a polyline; stroke a 40 wide paper band up to unroll*length; squiggles from K.noise along it; icons placed at path fractions; droop by blending the last control point down with swing().

new_assets.name: flush (soft option)
new_assets.description: Planned: pink dot cheeks, no steam.
new_assets.implementation: Two red Ben-Day dot discs on the cheeks with alpha = amount, drawn after the face.

new_assets.name: tiptoe
new_assets.description: Sneaking gait for the person figure: short stride, high knee, rise on each step.
new_assets.implementation: walk(xf, t, {stride: 0.5 * default}) plus sq 1 + 0.04 * step pulse and y lift 6 px from footfalls(); no sliding because phase still comes from distance.

new_assets.name: purse, hourglass, mantle, iconBalloon, handOver
new_assets.description: Planned small props and helpers under their planned names; mantle is a simple cloth for this story.
new_assets.implementation: Flat paths; handOver eases the object from hand A to hand B over 0.25 s with a dip.

owner_questions: Bath staging: Zubaydah is never shown undressed; she goes behind an opaque folding screen and only her veiled head (and a sleeved hand with the vessel) is seen. Default: yes, keep the screen in every bath shot.
Her veil stays on while she bathes and "undressing" is shown only as her outer mantle thrown over the screen. Default: yes.
The peeping is filmed on Harun's face in the leaves; there is never a view through his eyes, and the bath stays a small distant screen. Default: yes.
"Could not conceal everything" is played as a clean gag: the mantle slips away and the tip of her veil and her eyes keep showing above the screen. Default: use this gag.
Addition: Harun is shown ashamed when caught (blushes, covers his own eyes, bumps a tree as he leaves); the script only says he saw and withdrew. Default: keep.
Addition: a sparrow acts as the garden's conscience (turns its back, pecks the caliph's crown, scolds him). Default: keep.
The "frank verses about her body" are shown only through hearts on the verse ribbon, the same screen icon, and the caliph blushing; no figure is drawn. Default: yes.

Invented English lettering: PRIVATE!, SO HOT!, SPLASH!, AHH!, TIP TOE, SHH!, PECK! PECK!, EEK!, OOPS!, BONK!, AHA!, OOH!, COMPLETE!, HA HA!, CLINK!, START HERE and the labels HALF A VERSE and ONE LINE. Default: keep; say if any should go.

Title and story suitability: the title card is not shown on screen, but the subtitles carry the script words "naked" and "body" verbatim. Default: subtitles unchanged, as the rules require; the owner may prefer to hold this story back from a children's channel.
Harun is drawn young (caliph preset with a black beard, age 0.25). Default: yes.

SCRIPT: the English is a condensed paraphrase of the Arabic (for example P8 Arabic names "the story of the secret visit and the bath", P1 Arabic says water was made to run in "from different directions"); both are kept verbatim.
implementation_notes: Discretion rule for the animator: in S4, S6, S7 and every thought cloud or ribbon icon, draw the lady figure fully clothed FIRST and the opaque bathScreen AFTER it; never draw skin other than face and hands; never reveal anything by moving the screen.
Start from Library/template; cues with w(p, n) from timing.json. All cue times in this plan are word starts from timeline.md.
Garden strip is 1600 wide: translate by camera; redraw palaceGarden front:true after the cast for the bush, trunks and foliage curtains (peek pattern: draw actor then occluder).
Set LIFE.t = t every frame for auto blinks; set noBlink during the caught stares (73.9 to 77.2 and 85.7 to 86.6).
Gaze: always lookAt() the partner or object; saccades with gazePlan(t, plan, 0.07) for scanning (49.4, 68.3, 105.9, 142.0).
Harun seated: person({costume:"caliph", age:0.25, sit:1, seat:"bench", x:A.throne.x, y:A.throne.sitY}). Use twoShot(poet, harun) for S11 to S15.
The LATER card at 90.24 hides the cut from the garden to the hall (camera keys 0.01 s apart at the card midpoint).
Panel-only shake on BONK! (88.9) and the pool drop (10.1); the caption panel never moves.
Effects (8 total, master 0.6) sit only in the measured gaps: 6.25, 16.55, 22.95, 42.48, 119.65, 132.67, 159.36, then 175.75 and 176.9 after the last word.
Thought cloud figures at least 110 px on screen; S9 cloud 420 x 300 at scale 0.5.
Call S.finish last every frame; lettering never covers a face; no en or em dashes.
warnings: Subject matter: a bathing scene and a husband spying. The plan keeps it modest, but the narration and verbatim subtitles still say "naked" and "body"; the owner must decide if the story suits the channel.
The narration has only four real pauses, so the film has few sound effects by design.

Subtitle P6: the English chunks 2 and 3 are in the opposite order to the Arabic chunks 2 and 3 (the supplied translation reorders the sentence); a 2 chunk split would avoid this but makes the Arabic chunk 16 words long.
Word "سمع" (45.16) and "لاحظت" (67.62) have long listed durations (start times may include silence); check the onsets before locking the first action of S5 and S7.
bathScreen top y (about 735) must be measured against the lady figure so that only head and neck show standing, and only eyes and veil top when ducked 45 units.
The person figure is front facing only: turns toward the bush are head tilts plus gaze, not profiles.
